title: Nothing Says Love Like an Empty Plate
caption:
Nothing says love like an empty plate.
She sets down steaming golden potato cakes, he takes one huge bite and lights up - 'This is so delicious!' - then the whole plate just vanishes.
Because 'I'm so glad you like it' is the sweetest reward for anyone who cooks with love.
What dish disappears fastest when YOU cook it?
Follow @fruit_drama_tv for more cozy little stories like this.
